Exercise 1.
a) ⁧مُدِيرُ مَكْتَبِ الوَزِيرِ⁩ The Director of the Minister's Office
b) ⁧رَئِيسُ مَجْلِسِ إِدَارَةِ البَنْكِ⁩ The Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Bank
c) ⁧مُوَظَّفُو وِزَارَةِ المَالِيَّةِ⁩ The staff of the Ministry of Finance are:
d) ⁧وَزِيرَا خَارِجِيَّةِ البَلَدَيْنِ⁩ The Foreign Ministers of the two countries
e) ⁧أَعْمَالُ تَرْمِيمِ المَدِينَةِ القَدِيمَةِ⁩ The restoration work of the old town
f) ⁧نَتَائِجُ انْتِخَابَاتِ مَجْلِسِ النُّوَّابِ⁩ The results of the election of the House of Representatives
Exercise 2.
1. ⁧السَّيَّارَةُ⁩ ( o ⁧المَدْرَسَةُ⁩ ): female; the way prefers the new car. The new car of the school director.
2. ⁧النَّتَائِجُ⁩ or ⁧الاِمْتِحَانَاتُ⁩ (plural of things → singular female); most likely to be the last examinations (s) or the most likely results
Recent events in the context. The results of the last exams of the students.
3. ⁧رَئِيسُ⁩ (Ministers are plural, the State does not have an ... ex-Minister of the country): ... the former Prime Minister of the country.
4. ⁧مَشْرُوعُ⁩ ( o ⁧قَانُون⁩ ): as undetermined as the chain; Usually a new bill is in place.
5. ⁧البَابُ⁩ ( o ⁧البَيْتُ⁩ ): male; the way prefers the open door. The open door of my grandfather's house.
6. ⁧القَرَارُ⁩ (male; A minister is not suddenly):           • The sudden decision of the Minister of Health. • The sudden decision of the Minister of Health.
Exercise 3.
a) ⁧أَطْلَقَتِ الحُكُومَةُ بَرْنَامَجًا يَهْدِفُ إِلَى دَعْمِ الشَّبَابِ⁩ . The government has launched a programme to support
Young people.
b) ⁧هٰذِهِ مَدِينَةٌ يَعِيشُ فِيهَا مِلْيُونُ شَخْصٍ⁩ . It's a city where a million people live.
c) ⁧نَشَرَتِ الصَّحِيفَةُ التَّقْرِيرَ الَّذِي كَتَبَهُ مُرَاسِلُهَا فِي عَمَّانَ⁩ . The newspaper published the report written by his
That's Amman.
d) ⁧وَقَّعَ الوَزِيرَانِ اتِّفَاقِيَّةً تَسْرِي خَمْسَ سَنَوَاتٍ⁩ . The two ministers signed a five-year agreement.
e) ⁧زَارَ الوَفْدُ مَصْنَعًا يَعْمَلُ فِيهِ أَلْفُ عَامِلٍ⁩ . The delegation visited a factory where a thousand workers work.
f) ⁧هُنَاكَ أَسْئِلَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ لَا يَمْلِكُ أَحَدٌ جَوَابًا عَنْهَا⁩ . There are many questions that no one can answer.
Exercise 4.
a) ⁧الاِجْتِمَاعُ المُقَرَّرُ عَقْدُهُ غَدًا⁩ The meeting scheduled for tomorrow is:
b) ⁧الاِنْتِخَابَاتُ المُقَرَّرُ إِجْرَاؤُهَا فِي الخَرِيفِ⁩ The elections scheduled for autumn will take place in the following year:
c) ⁧الرَّئِيسُ المُتَوَقَّعُ وُصُولُهُ مَسَاءً⁩ The President expected in the evening
d) ⁧المُتْحَفُ المُزْمَعُ افْتِتَاحُهُ فِي الرَّبِيعِ⁩ The museum that will be inaugurated in the spring
e) ⁧النَّتَائِجُ المُنْتَظَرُ الإِعْلَانُ عَنْهَا الأُسْبُوعَ المُقْبِلَ⁩ The expected results for next week are:

Exercise 5. 1. Nobody understood what the minister meant. · 2. Anyone who's late to the appointment has no right to come in. · 3. Prices have risen by twenty percent, which has aroused the anger of the inhabitants. · 4. She was among the first to call for a reform of education. · 5. The decision concerned all public institutions, including universities. · 6. The opposition accused the government of hiding the data, which the minister denied.
Exercise 6.
a) ⁧مِنَ المُقَرَّرِ أَنْ تُعْقَدَ القِمَّةُ فِي الرِّبَاطِ⁩ . The summit is expected to be held in Rabat.
b) ⁧مِنْ بَيْنِ المُشَارِكِينَ فِي المُؤْتَمَرِ وُزَرَاءُ وَخُبَرَاءُ⁩ . Among the participants in the conference are ministers and experts.
c) ⁧فِي المَدِينَةِ ثَلَاثَةُ مَتَاحِفَ⁩ . There are three museums in town.
d) ⁧لِلشَّرِكَةِ مَكَاتِبُ فِي خَمْسِ دُوَلٍ⁩ . The company has offices in five countries.
e) ⁧مِنَ المُرَجَّحِ أَنْ يَتَأَخَّرَ القِطَارُ سَاعَةً⁩ . The train will probably delay by an hour.

Reconstruction: "In the margin of the inauguration of a solar power plant in the south of the country, the president of the board of directors of the national electricity company has told journalists that the company is implementing a plan to bring the share of renewable energy to 30% by 2030. The new power plant, which costs $200 million, will provide electricity to more than one hundred thousand homes. ⁧الوطنية⁩ agrees with ⁧الشركة⁩ (female, determined), not ⁧مجلس⁩ or ⁧رئيس⁩ .

Exercise 9. a) Data sheet: service (article signed by Sāmī al-ʿAṭṭār), economics section; topic: launch of the second fast train phase; sources: statement from the Ministry of Transport (official source), minister (direct quote), opposition MPs (critics attributed: ⁧ما وصفوه بـ⁩ « ⁧غياب الشفافية⁩ (ii) environmental associations; context: project announced six years ago, delayed by the economic crisis. Chains of iḍāfa: ⁧لجنة متابعة المشاريع الكبرى⁩ · ⁧برئاسة رئيس الحكومة⁩ · ⁧تفاصيل الصفقات المتعلقة بالمشروع⁩ (with share) · ⁧ممثلي هذه الجمعيات⁩ . Descriptive phrases without ⁧الذي⁩ : ( ⁧بثلاث مدن ساحلية⁩ ) ⁧يعيش فيها نحو مليوني نسمة⁩ · ( ⁧منطقة رطبة⁩ ) ⁧تعد محطة لآلاف الطيور⁩ · ( ⁧خطة وطنية⁩ …) ⁧تأخر تنفيذها⁩ . Participle + maṣdar: ⁧والمقرر أن تنتهي أعماله⁩ (Variation with ⁧أن⁩ ) · ⁧ومن المزمع أن تعقد⁩ . Predicate anticipated: ⁧ومن المزمع أن تعقد الوزارة⁩ … b) Some members of the opposition, for lack of transparency in the award of contracts (ask for details of contracts to be published); environmental associations, because the line crosses a wetland, a stage of thousands of migratory birds. The Ministry will meet representatives of associations to discuss changes to the route. c) Benefits: saving buildings at risk of collapse, modernising water and sewage, more tourists and jobs. Fear: As property prices rise, families sell to investors and the city empties in winter, becoming an outdoor museum. Proposals: support for rents for low-income families, limit to the share of houses converted into tourist facilities. The official: fears are exaggerated, tourism has created hundreds of jobs, the municipality studies a law on short rents. Anonymous source ( ⁧فضل عدم الكشف عن اسمه⁩ ): must be reported as such ('an official of the municipality who has requested anonymity') and the word 'exaggerated' between quotation marks. Exercise 10. 1. The President of the House received this morning a delegation from the European Parliament visiting the country as part of a regional tour in three countries. 2. The House should discuss next week the draft law on the regulation of short rents, which has provoked a wide debate. 3. The director of the new university hospital has assured that the first phase of the project, financed by a loan from the National Bank, will be completed by the end of the year. 4. The association invited the competent authorities to take urgent measures to save buildings at risk of collapse, including old schools. 5. The company had announced a staff reduction plan, which caused the protests of the unions. Delicate points: in 1 ⁧يزور البلاد⁩ is a descriptive phrase of ⁧وفدا⁩ (Surveying) in 2 ⁧من المقرر⁩ it is good with the "should" or "is expected to be," and ⁧الذي⁩ refers to ⁧مشروع القانون⁩ , not rents; in 3 ⁧الجديد⁩ agrees with ⁧المستشفى⁩ (male), not ⁧مدير⁩ ; ⁧الممولة⁩ with ⁧المرحلة⁩ ; in 4 ⁧بما في ذلك⁩ Incl.: ... in 5 ⁧مما أثار⁩ It relates to the whole sentence above. Exercise 12.
a) Because society and administration are feminine and the adjective is masculine. With the sense: who resigns is a
person. Rewording with ⁧لِـ⁩ : ⁧اِسْتِقَالَةُ الرَّئِيسِ الجَدِيدِ لِمَجْلِسِ إِدَارَةِ الشَّرِكَةِ.⁩
b) In the end: ⁧أَنْ تُعْقَدَ⁩ I would also like to thank the President-in-Office of the Council for his excellent work. To give the important information immediately: if it is
decided, expected or possible (the degree of certainty). Do not translate into the Arabic order: disassemble and reassemble the sentence.

C · Model translation. As part of a programme for the protection of the heritage, the Ministry of Culture announced the restoration of the old municipal library, built in the 18th century. The work, which will begin next month, should be completed within two years. 4 if there is all the information; 3 if a detail is missing (e.g. within two years) 2 if information changes in meaning (for example, work began last month, or next month becomes the end date). Delicate points: ⁧المقرر إطلاقها⁩ refers to ⁧الأعمال⁩ ; ⁧على أن⁩ introduces the forecast on the end of the work.
